label: PF Backlog 581
title: Eventing SSOT (Go): alert policy - rules, throttle, escalation
body:
## Problem / why
Alert routing is inline in orchestration_context._POLICY; no persisted rules, throttling, or escalation.

## Goal / value
A policy engine mapping event type/severity -> channels with throttle and escalation (reusing the policy map).

## In scope
- Alert-rule store + evaluation; throttle/dedupe window; escalation to HIL/backlog on critical kinds.

## Out of scope
- Transport delivery (E5).

## Acceptance criteria
- Terminal/failed events route to configured channels; duplicate alerts are throttled; critical escalates.

## Verification / test plan
- Policy table unit tests; throttle test.
